Welcome, Thinking Paleontologist
My name Date 
A paleontologist digs up old bones and fossils and thinks hard about what
they mean. In this workbook you dig into stories. You ﬁnd feeling words.
You weigh a choice. You say because. You draw what you think.
Every story has four lessons. Every lesson has one page. The four pages
always go in the same order:
Dig Find the feeling words in the story. Excavation
Weigh Answer the Big Question. Which side do I stand
on?
Strata
Because Say my idea and my because. Justiﬁcation
Show Draw it. Link it to nature. Impact
Your
Word
Fossils. A Word Fossil is a word you dig out of a story and
keep forever. Feeling words are the best fossils: happy, worried, brave,
proud. Collect as many as you can!
How
to
use
your
pages. Your teacher or a grown-up reads the book aloud
ﬁrst. Then you do the page. You can draw, write, trace or ask for help. All
answers that come with a because are good answers.
